revision_01_additions.source_syllabus_text: define price elasticity of demand and supply
revision_01_additions.visual_requirements: Use common axes/scales and a stated reference point or explicit numerical elasticities. Steepness alone across different scales does not establish elasticity. No unqualified straight-line slope=elasticity rule.

revision_01_additions.provenance: judgement: bounded revision under original syllabus outcome
revision_01_additions.source_syllabus_text: define price elasticity of demand and supply
revision_01_additions.visual_requirements: Construct two supply curves with specified differing responsiveness at a declared reference point. Label axes/units and verify elasticities from the data. A supply line through the origin is unit elastic; cover limiting cases in the notes without overcrowding the card.
